milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block', max_count=2) because red stained glass panes drop NOTHING when broken without Silk Touch. The player has a regular iron pickaxe, so no item enters inventory — inventory_has would never trigger. Instead, we check that at least one of the 3 originally-placed panes has been removed from the world by verifying at most 2 remain in the region encompassing all pane positions (spawn-relative x:-2 to 2, y:1 to 3, z:2 to 4).
